patterns.comment: A diagram comment has the mark %% and the text after it up to the line terminator as its value; U+2028 and U+2029 inside a diagram comment do not end it. c4.md#comments: A diagram comment has the mark `%%` and the text after it up to the line terminator as its value; the line terminator remains outside the comment and can separate statements. c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts: A keyword context tries end of text, `(` followed by ASCII spaces and `,`, ordinary `(`, and `)`, in that order.

Rule 2: title and accDescription, each followed by one whitespace character and nonempty text without #, ;, or LF, make their whole line-value unit. Quotes and percent pairs are text. The whole remainder of an accepted title line is its value; the excluded converted characters are not validated here. Directives inside titles are trivia within their values, including before the separator. Retain this local context: permits Notation whitespace, including line terminators, around the delimiter and preserves inline percent pairs in the value. Retain this local title form: uses exactly one Notation whitespace separator and preserves percent pairs in its line value. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. c4.md#the-top-level-context: `title` and `accDescription`, each followed by one whitespace character and nonempty text without `#`, `;`, or LF, make their whole line-value unit. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Rule 3: accTitle and accDescr enter their value context at the colon, and accDescr enters its block context at the opening brace. A directive between two complete units is allowed. The keyword context reads either delimiter after whitespace and directives; bare words inside text contexts stay text. Retain this local context: permits Notation whitespace, including line terminators, around the delimiter and preserves inline percent pairs in the value. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. c4.md#the-top-level-context: `accTitle` with optional whitespace, `:`, and optional whitespace enters its line-value context; `accDescr` with the same colon form follows it, then `accDescr` with optional whitespace, `{`, and optional whitespace enters the block context. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

c4-colon-value.comment: A colon enters the line-value context, whose value is the rest of the line after optional whitespace. Leave the following whitespace outside the begin match so a separator before a common comment remains available to #comment-line. c4.md#title-and-accessibility-contexts: In a colon accessibility context, the value is the rest of the line, including `#`, `;`, quotes, and percent pairs, without exterior whitespace. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

c4-brace-value.comment: The description block reads through the first closing brace; interior opening braces and percent pairs are text. Leave the following whitespace outside the begin match so a separator before a common comment remains available to #comment-line. c4.md#title-and-accessibility-contexts: The rest of that line-value unit preserves additional leading and trailing whitespace and treats quotes and percent pairs as text. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

c4-string-argument.comment: Rules 3 and 4: ASCII spaces before a double quote are padding, including when directives separate them. A tab before a quote instead starts bare text. Rule 5: ASCII spaces followed by $ enter the named-key context. After $, the key is every character up to the next =, including commas, ), whitespace, and line terminators, and may be empty. A common comment after a line separator or paragraph separator ends this value before the separator. c4.md#the-keyword-and-argument-contexts: ASCII spaces followed by `$` enter the named-key context. common.md#comment-lines: Comment lines are recognized independently of the diagram's syntax and of the context the lexer is in.

Rule 6: Bare text takes the longest nonempty run of characters other than a comma, including whitespace, quotes, braces, ), and line terminators. A closing parenthesis after its beginning belongs to the value.
